unit.why: A short memorate: R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozla sees his late master and father-in-law R. Zvi (of Zhidachov) after his death and converses with him about his place in the upper Garden of Eden.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש סיפר מורינו הק' מוהרי״א ז"ל מזידיטשוב
stories.summary_en: R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozla saw his master and father-in-law R. Zvi after his passing; asked whether he had reached his place in the upper Garden of Eden, R. Zvi said he will not go there until he has repaired all his followers.
